mentions.name: Alyph
mentions.description: Alyph is a canvas-based AI workspace where users work on one board instead of a dozen chat tabs: they can branch conversations anywhere, hot-swap between multiple frontier AI models against the same context or files, and avoid copy-paste and tab switching between model providers.
mentions.problem: Very long, months-old ChatGPT threads break down — typing gets slow and hallucinations increase — and running multiple frontier models against the same context or files previously required constant copy-pasting and tab switching.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Alyph — a canvas-based AI workspace.
